public_funding_totals_mad.notes: Cour des comptes report on 2023 party accounts (published May 2024). State support 'actually granted' 60.38 MDH vs 140 MDH budget line; 60.48 MDH incl. women-representation support.
Derived from the 2023 report ('baisse de 25,5 % par rapport à 2022 (81,17 MDH)'). Restitutions to Treasury during 2022: 18.28 MDH.

Cour des comptes 2021 report (published Feb/Mar 2023). Annual support figure (58.80 MDH) is derived as total resources minus campaign contribution minus own resources; the report's own headline figure should be checked. Restitutions: 7.68 MDH in 2021, 18.28 MDH in 2022, 2.89 MDH to end-April 2023 (16 parties); 14 parties still owed 21.85 MDH (Le360) / 'about 22 MDH awaiting restitution' (LesEco).

Cour des comptes 2020 report (Dec 2021). Retrieved facts: restitutions of 7.09 MDH (2020) and 7.34 MDH (2021 - note: the 2021 report says 7.68 MDH for 2021, discrepancy recorded); 195,000 MAD granted for strengthening women's political representation; state-financing shares: PAM 81%, PJD 49%, Istiqlal 47%, RNI 22%. Total annual support amount not captured in snippets.

Cour des comptes 2019 report: 5.06 MDH restituted by nine parties; resource shares PJD 29.43%, RNI 28.82%, PAM 14.9%, Istiqlal 9.24% (year attribution per LesEco/Le360 snippets; verify against the report). Total annual support amount not captured.
Report exists (courdescomptes.ma, synthèse PDF). Amounts not captured this session.
Reports for 2016 and 2017 exist on the Cour des comptes 'audit des comptes des partis politiques' mission page; amounts not captured this session.

parties_failing_to_justify_spending.summary: 15 of 29 parties had expenses with 'insuffisances' totalling 5.14 MDH (4.17% of declared management expenses), up from 1% in 2020; 5 of 34 parties did not submit accounts at all and 11 submitted late. Individual party names were not captured in the snippets - see the report's annexes.

Le Desk: 'les mêmes critiques d'année en année' - recurring findings of unjustified expenses and non-restitution; 14 parties owed 21.85 MDH in unspent/unjustified support (Le360). Party names not captured.
